name: Porridge with Berries
instructions: Simmer oats in milk for 5 minutes, top with berries and a drizzle of honey.

name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
instructions: Whisk eggs with milk, cook gently in butter, serve on toast.

name: Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Layer yogurt, berries and oats in glasses.

name: Pancakes
instructions: Whisk batter, fry thin pancakes in butter, serve with strawberries and honey.

name: Full Cooked Breakfast
instructions: Grill sausages and bacon, fry eggs, mushrooms and tomatoes, serve with toast.

name: Banana Oat Smoothie
instructions: Blend everything until smooth.

name: Ham & Cheese Sandwiches
instructions: Butter bread, fill with ham, cheese and lettuce.

name: Chicken Caesar Wraps
instructions: Grill chicken, slice, wrap with lettuce, parmesan and dressing.

name: Tomato Soup & Toast
instructions: Soften onion and garlic, add tomatoes, simmer and blend, finish with cream.

name: Hummus Veggie Wraps
instructions: Spread hummus, add sliced veg and roll.

name: Chickpea Salad
instructions: Toss everything together with lemon and oil.

name: Cheese Toasties
instructions: Fill bread with cheese, butter outside, toast in a pan.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Brown mince with onion, garlic and carrot, add tomatoes, simmer 30 minutes, serve over pasta.

name: Baked Salmon with Broccoli & Rice
instructions: Bake salmon with lemon at 200C for 15 min, steam broccoli, serve with rice.

name: Chicken Stir Fry
instructions: Stir fry chicken and veg on high heat, add soy, serve with rice.

name: Homemade Pizza
instructions: Top wraps with tomato, cheese and toppings, bake 10 minutes.

name: Frozen Pizza Night
instructions: Bake pizzas per packet, serve with a side salad.

name: Chicken Nuggets & Chips
instructions: Oven-bake nuggets and chips, boil peas.

name: Creamy Pesto Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta, stir through pesto, cream, spinach and parmesan.

name: Sausage & Mash
instructions: Grill sausages, mash potatoes with butter and milk, serve with peas and onion gravy.

name: Cod with Sweet Potato Wedges
instructions: Roast wedges 25 min, bake cod for the last 12 minutes, wilt spinach.

name: Chilli con Carne
instructions: Brown mince with onion, pepper and garlic, add beans and tomatoes, simmer 30 min, serve with rice.

name: Tofu & Veg Curry
instructions: Fry tofu, add onion, garlic and veg, simmer in tomatoes with curry spices, serve with rice.

name: Roast Chicken Thighs & Veg
instructions: Roast thighs with potatoes and carrots at 200C for 45 min, steam broccoli.

name: Garlic Prawn Linguine
instructions: Saute garlic and prawns, add tomatoes, toss with pasta, lemon and herbs.

name: Apple & Peanut Butter
instructions: Slice apples, serve with peanut butter.

name: Ice Cream Sundae
instructions: Scoop ice cream, top with strawberries and grated chocolate.
